digest.component_or_area: dependency-link escalation propagation (library and MCP write paths)
propositions: A cross-subtree blocking link is silently escalated to a different edge, and library and MCP callers are told only 'ok' with no indication a different edge was recorded.
The redirect record is emitted only to stdout via _emit_redirect and never returned, so only the CLI sees it while in-process callers do not.
The fix makes the redirect record a return value threaded through add_dependency, link_core, the _link closure, _python_leaf, and rebar.link(), instead of removing quiet.
quiet=True must stay because rebar-mcp speaks MCP-over-stdio and an unsuppressed print would corrupt the JSON-RPC stream and other in-process callers.
_python_leaf is shared by all Tier B leaf writes and is widened from -> None to return its inner call, keeping the CommandError->RebarError exit-code mapping uniform.
link_tickets keeps its str return, returning 'ok' when nothing escalated and 'ok (escalated: {src}->{tgt} recorded as {rsrc}->{rtgt})' otherwise, avoiding an outputSchema change.
